capabilities: Fetch YouTube video data via the YouTube Data API
Create a note from a YouTube video URL with a single command
Configure the template folder, template, and chapter and hashtag formats
extras: The README does not show the templates themselves or example output; setup requires creating a Google Cloud project and enabling YouTube Data API v3 before the plugin works.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to pull YouTube video metadata (like chapters) into a templated note, so note-taking on videos must be done manually.

requires.name: Google Cloud project with YouTube Data API v3 enabled

summary: Plugin that takes a YouTube video URL and creates a note from it using a configurable template, filling it with data fetched from the YouTube Data API.
